description: List the court deadline types 1Court can calculate for a jurisdiction. Available ids: TX; CA (civil), CA-FAM (family), CA-PROB (probate), CA-UD (unlawful detainer), CA-SC (small claims), CA-GOV (government claims), CA-CRIM (criminal), CA-JUV (juvenile dependency and delinquency), CA-PRESUIT (employment and pre-suit clocks: FEHA, EEOC, PAGA, arbitration fees, med-mal notice, CEQA, mechanics liens), CA-AGENCY (WCAB, OAH, CUIAB, SPB, PERB, Labor Commissioner), CA-APP (appeals and writs); US (federal civil and appellate), US-BK (bankruptcy). Add county (California superior court, e.g. los-angeles) or court (cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9 for US; cacb, canb, casb, caeb for US-BK; 1dca to 6dca for CA-APP) to include local rules. Returns each deadline with the governing rule citation for each. Use before calculate_deadline to get valid deadline_type ids.

county.description: California county slug for local rules, e.g. "los-angeles", "san-diego" (CA sets only)

court.description: Court for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9 (US); cacb, canb, casb, caeb (US-BK); 1dca, 2dca, 3dca, 4dca, 5dca, 6dca (CA-APP)

state.description: Rule-set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-PRESUIT, CA-AGENCY, CA-APP, US, or US-BK

name: list_deadline_rules
